name: Sebastopol
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Sebastopol for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events across Sebastopol, Graton, Forestville and Guerneville, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Sebastopol Christmas Tree Lighting) through December 20 (Sebastopol Nutcracker Ballet), with the Holiday Lights and Tractor Parade in Graton, the Forestville Holiday Faire and the Guerneville Parade of Lights (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Sebastopol

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Sebastopol and the west county
  • 3 free events: the Sebastopol Christmas Tree Lighting, the Guerneville Parade of Lights and the Graton lights and tractor parade
  • Meet Santa: the Sebastopol tree lighting, where Santa arrives on a firetruck (December 3)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Sebastopol (December 3), Guerneville (December 5) and Graton
  • Shows: the Sebastopol Nutcracker Ballet (December 19 and 20)
  • Crafts: Paint a Nutcracker at Sebastopol Hardware and the Forestville Holiday Faire
  • Season: December 3 to December 20

Planning a bigger day out? Sebastopol families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Santa Rosa, which covers Winter Lights, Snoopy's Home Ice shows and the Railroad Square carriage rides.

seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Sebastopol, California for 2026: a tree lighting, the Nutcracker, west county parades and more, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Sebastopol gathers on its Town Plaza for a free tree lighting where Santa arrives on a firetruck, and the west county around it adds parades in Graton and Guerneville, a holiday faire in Forestville and a Nutcracker ballet.
celebrates: The City of Sebastopol hosts its annual Tree Lighting Celebration in the Sebastopol Town Plaza, with performances by the Analy Jazz Band, Sebastopol Ballet and Mr. Music, and a special appearance by Santa Claus, who arrives on a firetruck. The city says families can warm up with free hot chocolate, hot cider, popcorn and cookies, and enjoy kid's crafts. It calls the night a magical evening for the whole community and says it is all free. Beyond the plaza, nearby Graton, Forestville and Guerneville each hold their own December events, and Sebastopol dancers stage a Nutcracker ballet at Analy High School.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap, so this page uses earlier coverage. A Press Democrat guide to holidays in Sebastopol described the annual Tree Lighting Ceremony with Santa arriving on the Sebastopol Fire Department fire truck. The Sebastopol Chamber of Commerce's listing for a past tree lighting named Santa Claus, holiday trivia and cartoons on the big screen, music, ballet, hot cocoa and cider, and a goat petting station, all free at the Town Plaza.
facts: The Sebastopol Town Plaza is the stage for the city's tree lighting, and a Sonoma County Tourism guide says a gorgeous tree is lit there each year before Santa arrives on a fire truck. The Chamber of Commerce's past listing gave the plaza address as 6908 Weeks Way. The Press Democrat guide also pointed shoppers to fresh cut trees, wreaths and garland in town. A 2022 local listing noted Santa arriving on his fire truck at 7 PM, so families often arrive early to visit shops.
trains: Sebastopol does not have its own holiday train in our research, but Bay Area families drive to the Western Railway Museum in Suisun City for Christmas train rides, and our California museum guide lists more rail stops across the state. Check the museum pages for 2026 dates before you go, because train schedules change each season.

kidfact: At Sebastopol's tree lighting, Santa does not come by sleigh. He rides in on a fire truck.
faq: The city's main event is the annual Tree Lighting Celebration in the Sebastopol Town Plaza, with music, ballet performances, free refreshments, kid's crafts and a visit from Santa Claus, who arrives on a firetruck. Nearby west county towns add their own parades and faires.
Is the Sebastopol tree lighting free?
Yes. The City of Sebastopol calls it a magical evening for the whole community and says it is all for free, including hot chocolate, hot cider, popcorn and cookies.
How does Santa arrive in Sebastopol?
The city says Santa Claus arrives on a firetruck at the tree lighting. A Press Democrat guide describes the Sebastopol Fire Department fire truck bringing him in.
Where is the Sebastopol Town Plaza?
The Chamber of Commerce's past listing gave the address as 6908 Weeks Way, Sebastopol. Check the city's page for the current year's details before you go.
Are there other Christmas events near Sebastopol?
Yes. Graton holds a lights and tractor parade, Forestville has a holiday faire and Guerneville has a Parade of Lights. Our listings for each are on this page.
